title: Aun o mohamed mere
body:
zainab ke dulaare aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed mere aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ye mere maan badhana bachon
surkh roo jang ke maidan se aana bachon
maut ko zeest ka unwaan banana bachon
pyase seh roz ke ho khoon may nahana bachon
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj ke din ke liye maine tumhe paala tha
ibne makhdooma e kaunain hai mushkil may ghira
aarzu aun o mohamed hai tumhari maa ki
dono ho jao mere bhai ke akbar pe fida
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm maidan may tum khao to khush ho maadar
shaan ajdaad ki dikhlao to khush ho maadar
suye darya na utha kar kabhi nazrein dekho
pyase dunya se guzar jao to khush ho maadar
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang is tarha karo ahl e wafa yaad kare
aise hamle ho jinhe shaami sada yaad kare
neemche khol ke lamhon may ulat do lashkar
daad abbas de aur sher e khuda yaad kare
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dum karun naad e ali sar ko jhuka lo bachon
saare armaan ladayi ke nikaalo bachon
haye sehra na saja sar pe tumhare lekin
maut ko aaj dulhan apni banalo bachon
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm zainab ka baja laaye dulaare bache
maut to haar gayi ran may na haare bache
dekh kar laashe pukari ye ali ki beti
surkh roo mai hui dunya se sidhare bache
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli maa laashon se kyun neend hai aayi utho
maa ko batlao ladi kaisi ladayi utho
ba adab tum ho bahot phir ye ghazab hai kaisa
kab se baali pe khade hai mere bhai utho
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaffri royi kahan bachon ko binte zehra
haa magar laut ke jab ghar may wo aayi dukhiya
khaali hujre jo nazar aaye to phir zabt hua
haat phailaye huwe ro ke ye zainab ne kaha
aun o mohamed mere...
author: Jaffri
